name: opsis-tasks
description: Cross-platform task runner. No dependencies: every script calls Docker or the frontend package.

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml run --rm --build tools pytest
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint:backend: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml run --rm --build tools sh -c "ruff check --no-cache opsis tests && ruff format --no-cache --check opsis tests && mypy --cache-dir=/tmp/mypy"
scripts.format:backend: docker run --rm -v ./backend:/app -w /app python:3.12-slim-bookworm sh -c "pip install -q --root-user-action=ignore ruff && ruff format --no-cache opsis tests && ruff check --no-cache --fix opsis tests"
scripts.lock:backend: docker run --rm -v ./backend:/app -w /app -e UV_LINK_MODE=copy python:3.12-slim-bookworm sh -c "pip install -q --root-user-action=ignore uv==0.13.8 && uv lock"
